observations.issue: Two blue cars and a block wall appear; only one car is allowed, and the child should raise the tunnel exit on two support blocks.
The child touches the teacher's palms; this first ritual should be with Mama, while teacher waits nearby.
Child walks beside bicycle; the learning step requires seated feet-on-ground gliding.
A large completed cardboard station appears too early; use loose wooden blocks and the cardboard train while family plans the activity.
Station should be constructed with wooden blocks, with roof only just placed; keep cardboard material restricted to the train.
Both top corners already meet the centre; keep one corner halfway folded to match this page's learning step.
